summary.title: LARSEN EIENDOM AS

narrative.text: LARSEN EIENDOM AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom", registered 1999-10-30.
Registered activity: Utleie av egen fast eiendom. Kranløfttjenester.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 144,000 and an annual result of NOK 91,107.
Registered leadership: Per Arvid Berg Larsen (Daglig leder); Per Arvid Berg Larsen (Styrets leder).
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
